The '''Gleaming Fortunes Casino''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], [[Haydnat Treen]], met with [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Drikl Lecersen]], [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Merratt Jaxton]], and the Senator of Coruscant, [[Fost Bramsin]], to play a game of [[Chambers/Legends|Chambers]] and conspire to overthrow Alliance [[Chief of State (Galactic Alliance)|Chief of State]] [[Natasi Daala]].
